plans.buy_case: FLEX is hitting classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 38.5 in oversold zone with price pinned to lower Bollinger Band while sitting above the 200MA—textbook bounce candidate. Volume is elevated and the BB squeeze suggests volatility compression before expansion, which typically favors the upside in a healthy trend (50MA > 200MA golden cross intact).
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 30-32 OR price to touch the lower BB ($116.50 area). Do NOT chase at $118.51—you need confirmation of mean reversion, not entry at the signal.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 65-70 or if price reclaims the 50MA ($141.54) with momentum. Hard stop: RSI breaks below 20 or price closes below 200MA ($86.83)—that breaks the thesis.
plans.risk: Insufficient recent fundamental news is a red flag—earnings surprises or negative guidance could torpedo this trade regardless of technicals. Also: $119 on a $3,763 portfolio is only ~3% position size, which is fine, but you have no margin for error. If technicals fail, you lose the entry entirely.

plans.buy_case: LUV is flashing textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 39.7 near your 20-30 buy zone, price hugging lower Bollinger Band, and a fresh golden cross with 200MA support intact. Volume confirmation + BB squeeze suggests coiled energy ready to snap back. This is a clean technical entry for a 3-4 week swing.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip into 20-30 zone OR price to touch lower BB more decisively (< $44.50). Don't chase at current $45.08—patience here protects your small account.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at RSI 60-65 (mean reversion target) OR price breaks above 50MA decisively. Hard stop: RSI drops below 25 (capitulation signal missed) or price breaks below $43.00 (loses 200MA support).
plans.risk: Airline sector is cyclical and sensitive to fuel costs, labor disputes, and macro slowdowns. Insufficient news context is a yellow flag—LUV could be weak for fundamental reasons not yet priced in. VIX at 18.6 is calm; a sudden spike could crush airlines first. Position size ($90 for 2 shares) is appropriately conservative for this uncertainty.

plans.buy_case: WST is a quality healthcare compounder hitting a technical inflection point: RSI in oversold territory (36.5), price at lower Bollinger Band, and BB squeeze suggesting imminent volatility expansion. The 50/200 MA golden cross confirms uptrend structure, and elevated volume on the dip signals institutional accumulation.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to touch 30–32 zone OR price to kiss the lower Bollinger Band (≈$322–324). Do NOT chase at current levels; let mean reversion work into your entry. This is a discipline test.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 65–70 or if price hits $350 target. Hard stop: break below lower BB + RSI falls back below 25 on heavy volume = trend failure, exit immediately.
plans.risk: Limited near-term catalyst or earnings visibility is a concern—WST could consolidate sideways for weeks rather than snap back quickly. Broader healthcare rotation risk if rates spike or sector rotates. Position size ($1,000–1,200) limits damage, but patience is critical.
plans.notes: This is a **conditional buy, not an immediate buy**. Your $3.7K portfolio should not chase; set alerts for RSI 30–32 and lower BB touch, then execute. Quality name + clean technicals + mean reversion setup = solid risk/reward IF you get the entry right. Discipline > urgency.

plans.buy_case: GNRC is flashing textbook mean-reversion signals: RSI at 29.5 (oversold), price kissing lower Bollinger Band, and MACD histogram turning up from a valley—all within a healthy 200MA structure. This is a classic swing setup for a bounce trade in a quality industrial name.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for one of two triggers: (1) RSI breaks above 35 on intraday strength, OR (2) price closes above the lower Bollinger Band with volume confirmation. Do not chase; let the setup come to you.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 65-70 or if price closes above 218 (upper BB zone). Hard stop: close the position if RSI drops back below 20 or price breaks below the 200MA (203.94) on volume.
plans.risk: Insufficient recent fundamental data (earnings, guidance, sector headwinds) creates blind spots. If GNRC reports negative guidance or the industrial sector rolls over, this could gap down hard. Position sizing is critical given your $3.7k portfolio—risk only $200–300 max on this trade.
plans.notes: The setup is *technically* clean, but the lack of recent news is a red flag. Before entry, spend 10 minutes checking: (1) latest earnings date and beat/miss, (2) analyst revisions in the last 30 days, (3) any sector rotation into/out of industrials. If fundamentals are deteriorating, pass. If clean, this is a solid 7–10% swing candidate.
